pages.title: Architecture Overview
pages.purpose: System overview: component ownership, end-to-end data/control flow from source file to validated Pydantic result
instructions: Explain the universal content format {content, images, metadata} from _map_to_universal_format, the message-builder seam, completion/vision branching, page-count plumbing, list-merge multi-document path, and _skip_loading used by Process.extract.

pages.title: Batch Processing
pages.purpose: Offline batch extraction: OpenAI Batch API job lifecycle, JSONL temp files, status polling, result parsing, cleanup
instructions: Explain extract_batch preconditions (model allow-list substring match, backend gate), JSONL paths under ./extract_thinker_batch with uuid names, _add_method_to_file OpenAI request-format rewrite, status mapping, 60s polling, parsed[0] return semantics, __del__ cleanup.
State that this path uses the OpenAI batch API directly regardless of the configured litellm model string.

pages.title: Classification & Splitting (Process)
pages.purpose: Process orchestration: multi-layer classification (consensus, higher-order, tree), eager/lazy splitting into document groups, group extraction
instructions: Cover classify layer semantics (extractor_groups layers, strategy handling, threshold 1-10 validation, tree walking matched by uuid), split requirements (>=2 pages, lazy only for paginable sources), and extract() reloading pages then delegating per-group with set_skip_loading.
Explain eager vs lazy mechanics including pairwise comparison and aggregate_doc_groups page indexing.

pages.title: Completion Strategies
pages.purpose: Long-output handling: FORBIDDEN vs PAGINATE vs CONCATENATE, per-page merge/conflict resolution, continuation loops
instructions: Detail ConcatenationHandler: raw_completion loop, JSON validation/retry max 3, code-fence cleaning, model_validate.

Detail PaginationHandler: make_all_fields_optional partial extraction, per-page ThreadPoolExecutor requests, list merging by unique key candidates, _conflict structures, LLM conflict resolution, continuation on IncompleteOutputException.
Explain FORBIDDEN raising ExtractThinkerError on incomplete/invalid output.

pages.title: Contracts & Shared Models
pages.purpose: Pydantic/enum data model: Contract, Classification, classification responses, doc groups, strategy enums, exceptions
instructions: Document field validators, uuid identity used by tree classification, extraction_contract fallback in Process.extract, the three strategy enums, doc group containers, exceptions hierarchy.
Note duplicate-ish DocGroups definitions (doc_group.py vs doc_groups.py) and eager_doc_group mixing dataclass and pydantic models.

pages.title: Document Loaders
pages.purpose: Loader hierarchy: capability detection, caching, vision/page formats, concrete loaders grouped by backend
instructions: Cover the ABC (can_handle/can_handle_vision/can_handle_paginate, vision_mode, max_image_size, URL screenshot via Playwright, pypdfium2 PDF rendering scale 300/72), TTL cache keyed on (source, vision_mode), per-loader Config dataclasses, lazy optional-dependency imports, and a capability table of SUPPORTED_FORMATS.
Note which loaders require external binaries/services (tesseract binary, Azure/AWS/Google/Mistral credentials).

pages.title: Evaluation Framework
pages.purpose: The extract_thinker.eval subsystem: Evaluator, datasets, field comparison, metrics, hallucination detection, cost tracking, report, CLI
instructions: Cover Evaluator per-document flow (schema accounting, type-based default comparisons, document accuracy = all fields correct), FileSystemDataset label validation, hallucination strategies, CostMetrics via litellm completion_cost, report fields, extract_thinker-eval console script, TeacherStudentEvaluator metrics.

pages.title: Extractor Core
pages.purpose: The central Extractor: dependency validation, loader resolution, universal content mapping, message building, extraction/classify/batch entrypoints, interceptor seams
instructions: Document loader selection precedence (get_document_loader vs get_document_loader_for_file), _validate_dependencies, ExtractThinkerError/VisionError wrapping, extract_batch gating, split_content/aggregate_results, thinking mode and page count plumbing.
Verify against source before asserting that _extract calls interceptor.intercept while the LlmInterceptor ABC declares process, and that loader_interceptors is never invoked.

pages.title: LLM Integration
pages.purpose: LLM abstraction: litellm+instructor default backend, optional pydantic-ai backend, router fallbacks, thinking/dynamic modes, token budgets
instructions: Explain backend selection, instructor MD_JSON mode, router-only-for-DEFAULT rule, thinking budget formula with min/max clamps, is_dynamic prompt injection with extract_thinking_json, raw_completion used by ConcatenationHandler.
Mention global_models presets and that LLMEngine defines DEFAULT and PYDANTIC_AI.

pages.title: Markdown Conversion
pages.purpose: MarkdownConverter: document-to-markdown and structured PageContent conversion with vision support
instructions: Explain to_markdown/to_markdown_structured flows, DEFAULT prompts, ContentItem certainty scores, allow_verification property, async wrappers.
Keep scope to what the module implements.

pages.title: How to Add a Document Loader
pages.purpose: Change guide: implement and register a new document loader end to end
instructions: Step-by-step: subclass CachedDocumentLoader, define SUPPORTED_FORMATS and a Config dataclass in existing idiom, implement load() returning list-of-page dicts, register exports in extract_thinker/__init__.py, add a tests/test_document_loader_*.py following BaseDocumentLoaderTest.

pages.title: Debugging Extraction Failures
pages.purpose: Change guide: diagnose failures from exception types, wrapped causes, and known silent-fallback behaviors
instructions: Do not invent logging infrastructure; the repo uses print.

Walk the source-visible failure surface: ValueError preconditions, ExtractThinkerError wrapping including ValidationError/JSONDecodeError-as-incomplete mapping, vision error classification, splitter fallbacks that keep pages together or return unknown classification, print-based diagnostics.

pages.title: Tuning Extraction Quality
pages.purpose: Change guide: choose contracts, completion strategies, thinking budgets, classification settings to improve accuracy
instructions: Cover contract effects on prompts (add_classification_structure), CompletionStrategy choice, thinking budget via set_page_count and LLM constants, consensus layers/thresholds, measuring with the eval framework and hallucination detector.

pages.title: Testing, CI & Release
pages.purpose: Ops: test tiers (offline vs live-API), CI workflows, poetry build/publish, lint/format config
instructions: Describe pytest layout, CI matrix (critical tests + build; version matrix only verifies install), pre-commit ruff config and its stale custom mypy script paths, manual-publish workflow, and the stale llm_engine.LITELLM reference in tests/test_llm_backends.py vs current enum members.
Flag which checks the repository establishes and which it does not (e.g., no test gate on publish). Do not document OpenWiki-generated files (AGENTS.md, openwiki-update.yml).

pages.title: Quickstart
pages.purpose: Task-oriented entry: install the package, run the first extraction, run tests, and route to deeper pages
instructions: Cite concrete files/lines; note live tests need credentials the repo does not provide.

Cover poetry-based install, requirements.txt extras not in poetry deps, provider API keys via env/litellm, the minimal Extractor+DocumentLoaderPyPdf+Contract flow, offline loader tests vs live-API critical tests.
